structured.reason: The closing section "Find Your Glow" does contain a clear call to action ("Add it to your cart today"). However, a horizontal rule follows it, and then two paragraphs of notes to the user about the omitted free brush, pre-publication verification, and shade-suitability claims. The criterion says no other content may follow the CTA, and notes to the user count as substantial non-CTA content, so it fails.
